title: Electric field strength
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (1) as E = 2U / R₁.

title: Magnetic induction magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (2) as B = (1/R₂) * sqrt(2mU / q).

title: Voltage variation range
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for part (3) as U/3 ≤ U' ≤ 3U.

title: Energy and force analysis
description: Important: Applies work-energy theorem to relate accelerating voltage to ion speed (qU = ½mv²).

title: Analyzer centripetal force
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion in the electrostatic analyzer (qE = mv²/R₁).

title: Magnetic centripetal force
description: Important: Applies Lorentz force as centripetal force in the magnetic field (qvB = mv²/r).

title: Geometric limit analysis
description: Important: Correctly identifies the geometric constraints (central angle of 120°) and radii (r = R₂ and r = √3 R₂) for the limiting trajectories on the wafer.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Successfully combines equations from energy, force, and geometry to solve for the required quantities.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in force direction or provides an answer with incorrect units.

title: Geometric misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly interprets the geometry of the circular arc in the magnetic field or the wafer placement, leading to wrong limiting radii.
